chapter: Harry Parker's, the district and its characters
title: Guitarists and drummers Allen asks about: Mumford, Gibson, the Nixons
summary: A run of quick questions about Brock Mumford, Frank Burnett, Hugh Rankin, Billy Peyton, Jim Gibson and the guitarist Philip Nixon and his brother Sam, a bass player.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel
